Hypixel отдаёт только число собранных фе: Hypixel only reports how many fairy souls you have, not which ones. Mark the ones you found on this page: island counters become accurate and "missing" shows only the real ones.
Координаты x y z удобно вставлять в мод: The x y z coordinates paste easily into a waypoint mod (SkyHanni, Skytils, NEU): the 📍 button copies them. Each island's list follows a route, from the warp to the nearest next soul.
Каждые 5 фей меняются у Tia the Fairy (H: Every 5 souls trade at Tia the Fairy (Hub, Fairy Pond in the Wilderness) for permanent +Health, +Defense, +Strength and +Speed. Trades never expire, so you can save up as many as you like.
Высокие души берутся с Aspect of the End: High souls are reached with Aspect of the End / Aspect of the Void and a Grappling Hook, underwater ones with a Water Breathing potion or a Respiration helmet.
Abiphone — телефон SkyBlock. Контакт доб: Abiphone is the SkyBlock phone. A contact is added by talking to an NPC while the phone is in your inventory; some NPCs need a condition from the table first.
Звонки — /call имя: Maddox берёт слеер-к: Calls use /call name: Maddox gives Slayer quests, Elizabeth opens the Bits shop, Fear Mongerer and Plumber Joe have their own shops and tasks. The number of contacts depends on the phone model: extras can be removed and added later.
Melody and her harp are in The Park. Songs unlock one by one: each next song after you finish the previous one.
Награда за первое прохождение песни — по: The reward for the first clear of a song is permanent +Intelligence (easy +1, hard +2, expert +3, virtuoso +4) and SkyBlock XP.
Ноты падают сверху по столбцам: жми слот: Notes fall down the columns: click the slot when a note reaches the bottom row. Turn off inventory animations in your mods and play with good ping.
Melody's Hair — аксессуар Epic (+6 Intel: Melody's Hair is an Epic accessory (+6 Intelligence, Accessory Power), given after you complete the whole harp.
